rundown: Knicks beat Timberwolves 102-99 at Target Center in Minneapolis, MN. Knicks led 65-50 at the half and held on. The 2nd quarter decided it: Knicks won it 32-24.
Leading the way — Knicks: Karl-Anthony Towns 22 pts, 12 reb; Jalen Brunson 7 ast. Timberwolves: Jonathan Kuminga 23 pts; LaMelo Ball 8 ast, 8 reb.
Where Knicks won it: they shot 45% to 44%, had 26 assists to 21 and turned it over 14 times to 16.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Knicks closed as 1.5-point favorites and covered by 1.5; the total closed at 216.5 and they combined for 201, under by 15.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 19, 7:57 PM ET. It had Knicks 47% and Timberwolves 53%, projecting Knicks 105.1 – Timberwolves 106 (211.1 total, Timberwolves by 0.8).

Final: Knicks 102 – Timberwolves 99. Wrong winner: it had Timberwolves at 53%, and Knicks (47%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Knicks came in with a league-average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (8-6, 110 scored and 103.9 allowed a game over 14 games), worth about 86 and 86 games of evidence. Projected to score 105.1, they scored 102 (−3.1 points, 3% under); projected to allow 106, they allowed 99 (−7 points, 7% under).

Timberwolves came in with a league-average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (11-4, 116.7 scored and 106.1 allowed a game over 15 games), worth about 87 and 87 games of evidence. Projected to score 106, they scored 99 (−7 points, 7% under); projected to allow 105.1, they allowed 102 (−3.1 points, 3% under).

The bigger miss was Timberwolves' scoring (-7 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 201 against 211.1 projected (-10.1), about the 29th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Knicks by 3 against Timberwolves by 0.8 projected, about the 37th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
MIN ML (-104) at -104: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (+0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 49%). NY ML (-113) at -113: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (-0.4 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 51%). MIN +1.5 (-119) at -119: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (+0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. NY -1.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (-0.6 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. OVER 216.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 216.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): spread: 61% of bets on Knicks, 63% of the money — Knicks covered; total: 81% of bets on the over, 72% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 59% of bets on Knicks, 67% of the money.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.948 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -4 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 116 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.995 and gives home teams -0.1 points. Team corrections so far: Knicks attack ×0.992, defense ×0.976 (8 games); Timberwolves attack ×0.982, defense ×0.974 (8 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
